build.beforeDevCommand: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path package.json) { npm run dev } elseif (Test-Path frontend/package.json) { npm run dev --prefix frontend } elseif (Test-Path ../frontend/package.json) { npm run dev --prefix ../frontend } elseif (Test-Path D:/grok/nexus/frontend/package.json) { npm run dev --prefix D:/grok/nexus/frontend } else { npm run dev }"
build.beforeBuildCommand: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path package.json) { npm run build } elseif (Test-Path frontend/package.json) { npm run build --prefix frontend } elseif (Test-Path ../frontend/package.json) { npm run build --prefix ../frontend } elseif (Test-Path D:/grok/nexus/frontend/package.json) { npm run build --prefix D:/grok/nexus/frontend } else { npm run build }"
